NEW YORK STATE SENATE

THE STENOGRAPHIC RECORD

ALBANY, NEW YORK

NOVEMBER 1, 2013

1:26 P.M.

REGULAR SESSION SENATOR KATHLEEN A. MARCHIONE, ACTING PRESIDENT FRANCIS W. PATIENCE, SECRETARY

P R O C E E D I N G S

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT MARCHIONE
turns.text:
THE SENATE WILL COME TO ORDER.

THE SECRETARY WILL BEGIN BY READING THE JOURNAL.

turns.label: THE SECRETARY
turns.text: IN SESSION, WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 30, 2013, THE SENATE MET PURSUANT TO ADJOURNMENT. THE JOURNAL OF MONDAY, OCTOBER 28, 2013, WAS READ AND APPROVED. ON MOTION, SENATE ADJOURNED.

turns.label: ACTING PRESIDENT MARCHIONE
turns.text: HEARING NO OBJECTION, THE JOURNAL WILL STAND APPROVED AS READ.

turns.text:
